claims.title: Phase-sensitive energy certificates and exact restricted 2D controls

quoted_fields.interface: The source develops exact ferromagnetic-sector marginal completion, a noncommuting defect-gated gapped ordered model, weighted source-faithful RK dimers, and a finite-field energy-plus-curvature criterion. Explicit counterexamples separate local energy accuracy, finite-field response and orthogonal matching amplitudes from the original frustrated Heisenberg phase target.
quoted_fields.failure: Source-authored restricted constructions with producer-reported finite exact controls; no independent whole audit, Capital science replay, novelty determination or new sign-off. Frustrated square-lattice J1-J2 alpha=1/2 phase and useful uniform dimer-response modulus remain OPEN. No generic marginal solver, Heisenberg-to-RK transfer, useful runtime advantage or physical device is established. Only seven new files are ingested; old uncertain baseline archive remains held/unopened/unreceived and baseline replay text is not receipt of its old code/witness/amplitudes.
